faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Technical answers about our demountable partitions, acoustics and technical systems in Morocco.
faq.faq1A: Inside Factory specialises in demountable partitions (office and industrial), acoustic solutions, technical ceilings and raised floors in Morocco — from design to installation. Second œuvre and turnkey projects are available as complementary services around this technical core.
faq.faq2A: Nationwide in Morocco — Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech and across the Kingdom — for tertiary, industrial, commercial and public projects.
faq.faq3Q: What types of partitions do you offer?
faq.faq3A: Office and industrial partitions: glazed, full-height, edge-to-edge, solid, cover-joint, bead, fire-rated and acoustic. Aluminium-frame doors. 2D/3D layout study and custom installation.
faq.faq4Q: What do you offer for ceilings?
faq.faq4A: Technical suspended ceilings and false ceilings: plasterboard, design tiles, Gyptone, methacrylate, rock wool. Acoustic performance, fire safety and moisture resistance — stock available for a fast start.
faq.faq5A: Technical raised floors (plancher technique) for cabling first, then finishes: parquet, PVC, carpet and epoxy resin — according to space type and your budget, coherent with partitions and ceilings.
faq.faq6A: An Inside Factory expert replies within 24 to 48 hours. Account managers and site managers then support you through to handover.
faq.faq7Q: Does acoustics depend only on partitions?
faq.faq7A: No. Acoustic performance is a system: partitions, technical ceilings, floors and doors must be specified together to reach the required sound insulation (Rw).
faq.faq8Q: Do you only offer technical systems?
faq.faq8A: Our core remains movable partitions, acoustics, technical ceilings and raised floors. Fit-out and turnkey projects are available as complementary services when the scope requires it.
